answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 35859 Country: India Title: I saw my late mother eating something in my dream, what does this mean? Kindly answer. Question: I saw my late mother eating something in my dream, what does this mean? Kindly answer. Answer ID: 35859 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 40/32/H=1433) Ma-sha-Allah, it is nice dream. It means that your mother was granted forgiveness and it is hoped that her status shall be raised in-sha-Allah. You should regularly do isal-e-sawab for her. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
